name: Watchoffit
description: Sync your Jellyfin playback with Watchoffit in real time, without API keys or webhooks.
overview: Pairs a Jellyfin server with a Watchoffit instance over a dedicated protocol. Once paired, Jellyfin playback events, watched state, library inventory, backfill, reconciliation, and outbound watched or unwatched changes stay in sync with Watchoffit.
